build_keypoint_head: build a keypoint head from the detectron2 config and input shape for ROI keypoint prediction
compute_keypoint_rcnn_loss: compute the keypoint R-CNN loss from predicted keypoint logits and ground truth instances
run_keypoint_rcnn_inference: run keypoint R-CNN inference to convert predicted heatmaps into x y score keypoints
create_BaseKeypointRCNNHead: create a BaseKeypointRCNNHead module with a specified number of keypoints and loss weight
create_KRCNNConvDeconvUpsampleHead: create a KRCNNConvDeconvUpsampleHead with conv layers transpose convolution and bilinear upsampling for keypoint prediction
